offer.say: Okay, don't laugh. The binder's haunted. There's new notes. In Gus's writing. WET notes. Gus is in Florida! He sent a postcard with a flamingo! Flamingos can't write! Will you come look? Not alone. Together. In daylight.

options.text: There's no such thing as ghosts, Dylan.

mail.say: The ink is WET. Do you know how long mail takes from Florida? A week! Ink dries in like a minute! I tested it! With my own marker!

cheek.say: NOT FUNNY. Okay a bit funny. But not in the plant room. Number 1 can hear you.

decline.say: That's what a ghost would want you to think.

accepted.say: The newest one's about me and the squeegee. Which, fair. But still. Haunted.

options.text: Going to look at the binder.
I'm watching on my morning rounds.
I've got a lead in the bay.
I need to ask someone something.

p_rounds.say: I'm not doing rounds alone till this is solved. I'm doing them with the radio on. CKVL. Ghosts hate CKVL. Probably.

p_earl.say: Who? Is it someone alive? Please say it's someone alive.

complete.say: Well? Is it a ghost? Be honest. No. Don't be honest. Yes. Be honest.

options.text: It's Earl. He writes in Gus's hand. It's how he tells us things.
It's a ghost. A friendly one. Do what the notes say.
It's somebody who cares whether you do the squeegee right.

c_truth.say: EARL? Earl writes notes to ME? Earl said 'the squeegee' to me through a ghost? That's... that's the nicest thing Earl's ever done. I'm going to do the squeegee perfectly forever.

c_ghost.say: A friendly ghost. Okay. Okay. I can live with a friendly ghost. I'll do the squeegee. I'm doing it out of respect. And fear.

c_cares.say: Somebody cares about my squeegee. Huh. I'll do it right, then. For them. Whoever them is.

done.say: New note today: GOOD SQUEEGEE. G. I'm framing it.
